info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Transportation and Logistics
info.sub_name: 整合型物流經營與管理

description.sub_name: 整合型物流經營與管理
description.describe_ch: 此課程介紹整合型物流經營與管理的重要觀念，包括城市物流、海空物流、電子商務物流、逆物流、緊急救災物流、事件物流、全球運籌網路、全球運籌策略、物流資訊管理。
description.describe_eh: This course introduce an essential concept of integrated logistics operations and management including city logistics, sea & air logistics, e-commerce logistics, reverse logistics, emergency logistics, event logistics, global logistics network, global logistics strategies, and logistics information management.

targets.describe_ch: 1. 培養學生運用運輸與物流專業理論解決實務問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: 1. Develop students' ability to apply professional transportation and logistics theories to solve practical problems.

targets.describe_ch: 7. 培養學生評析與討論國內外運輸或物流時勢議題之能力。
targets.describe_en: 7. Develop students' ability to analyze and discuss domestic and international current issues in transportation and logistics.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Group discussions and assignments will account for 40% of the grade. 
A final peer review will be done on group work. 

2. A midterm exam will account for 30% of the grade. 
The midterm exam will be in class, closed book. It will consist of a series of short conceptual questions.

3. A final project will account for 30% of the grade. 
A final presentation: 20 minutes
Please submit your final report and presentation slides (6 slides per page) [print on both sides] on your presentation day!
1. 討論與作業佔總成績40%，期末執行同儕互評。
2. 期中考佔總成績30%
3. 期末考佔總成績30%，期末報告與簡報須於期末報告前繳交，書面報告請雙面列印。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
上課過程中請嚴守遊戲規則（不遲到、不使用行動裝置、不睡覺、不做非課內事）！

違反三次以上遊戲規則總成績打折，從第4次開始，總成績*0.9；違反5次總成績*0.8；以此類推！

1. 每堂課必點名，點完名後翹課，則違反次數乘以３倍！
2. 手機出現在桌上、手上、腳上...等（含以手機拍照替代抄筆記），記一次違反「不使用行動裝置」遊戲規則！
3. 只要趴在桌上，就算是違反「不睡覺」之遊戲規則！
4. 若違反遊戲規則，每堂下課請主動申報；若未主動申報違反遊戲規則，經查知，則違反次數乘以３倍！亦歡迎檢舉喔~


Rules of the Game
– When you are in class, you are expected to fully follow the principles of the Feng Chia code of classroom etiquette. 
– Several important etiquette aspects in my class are:
• Please make sure to be seated in class on time (before completion of roll call). 
• All mobile devices must be turned off before the start of class. Mobile phone will be confiscated.
• Please do not sleep during class.
• Please don't do things unrelated to the course.

– Violating any rules will result in a reduced chance of passing this course.
• After the third violation of any one rule, total grades will be automatically and indisputably reduced by 10% for any subsequent violation (4 violations = 10% grade reduction; 5 violations = 20% grade reduction; 6 violations = 30% grade reduction; etc.).
